test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which one set of letters when sequentially placed at the gaps in the given letter series shall complete it? 

bc_bcccbcc_ _ _ccccc
solution:
Given series: bc_bcccbcc_ _ _ccccc 

Option 1) cccc → bc__c__bcccbcc__c__ __c__ __c__ccccc → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) ccbc → bc__c__bcccbcc__c__ __b__ __c__ccccc → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) cbcc → bc__c__bcccbcc__b__ __c__ __c__ccccc → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) cccb → bc__**c**__bcccbcc__**c**__ __**c**__ __**b**__ccccc → (It follows the pattern of: bcc - bccc - bcccc - bccccc)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
